description.en: The remains of an old wall, under a modern square.

description.en: A small museum, good on a rainy day.

description.ca: Un petit museu, bo per a un dia de pluja.
description.de: Ein kleines Museum, gut für einen Regentag.

description.en: A play park for kids, with a shady picnic area.
